title: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper
description: Extract Trustpilot reviews for any company. Enter domains (e.g. apple.com), full Trustpilot URLs, or company names.

companyIdentifiers.title: Companies to Scrape
companyIdentifiers.description: Use this field when the user provides domains (e.g. 'apple.com'), Trustpilot review URLs (e.g. 'https://www.trustpilot.com/review/apple.com'), or company names (e.g. 'Apple'). Enter one per line. Accepts all three formats — the actor resolves each to the correct Trustpilot page automatically.
companyIdentifiers.sectionDescription: Enter domains, Trustpilot URLs, or company names — one per line.

maxReviewsPerCompany.title: Max Reviews Per Company
maxReviewsPerCompany.description: Maximum number of reviews to scrape per company. Set to 0 for unlimited (scrapes all available reviews). Default is 100.

filterStars.title: Filter by Star Rating
filterStars.description: Only scrape reviews with these star ratings. Leave empty to scrape all ratings. Use when the user wants only positive reviews (4-5 stars) or only negative reviews (1-2 stars).
filterStars.sectionDescription: Narrow down which reviews to collect.

filterLanguage.title: Filter by Language
filterLanguage.description: Only scrape reviews written in this language. Use ISO 639-1 codes: 'en' for English, 'de' for German, 'fr' for French, 'es' for Spanish, 'nl' for Dutch. Leave empty for all languages.

filterDateRange.title: Filter by Date Range
filterDateRange.description: Only scrape reviews published within this date range. Leave empty to scrape all dates.

sortBy.title: Sort Reviews By
sortBy.description: Sort order for reviews. 'recency' returns newest first. 'relevance' returns most helpful first (Trustpilot default).

onlyVerified.title: Verified Reviews Only
onlyVerified.description: When enabled, only scrape reviews from verified purchases or verified invitations. Reduces quantity but improves data quality for market research.

onlyWithReplies.title: Reviews With Company Reply Only
onlyWithReplies.description: When enabled, only scrape reviews that have received a reply from the company. Useful for analyzing how companies handle customer feedback.

includeCompanyInfo.title: Include Company Profile Data
includeCompanyInfo.description: When enabled, each review record includes company metadata: trust score, total review count, categories, and domain. Disable to reduce output size when only review content is needed.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
